defect_a.id_source: RESOLVED FROM A LOCAL FILE, not read from Figma. The applied plan-text-B.json set 154:25 to 'Auto-fix isn't available yet — the linter reports what is wrong, not what to replace it with. Edit the token in Tokens.' VIS-1-22 quotes the clipped render as '…not what to replace it with. Edit' and then nothing. Same string, same node.
defect_a.what: the closing note is cut off mid-sentence at the frame's bottom-right — the sentence runs past the text frame
defect_a.fix: grow the note's frame by one line (about 18px) so the full sentence renders. Do NOT shorten the string to end at '…not what to replace it with.' — the sentence's second half is the actionable half, and FIG-F-14 put it there on purpose.
defect_a.guard: if growing the frame pushes it past the board's 812 bottom, take the height out of the spacer above it, not out of the sentence.

defect_b.id_source: RESOLVED FROM A LOCAL FILE. plan-text-B.json set 154:17 to 'Banned hue — purple, violet or indigo · color-accent', which VIS-1-22 quotes verbatim as the row that breaks to four ragged lines against the 'Open' action.
defect_b.what: the issue-row detail text wraps against the 'Open' action instead of clearing it
defect_b.fix: give the issue-row detail text a 48px right inset
defect_b.conflict_to_resolve_first: FIG-F-12's truth is that the shipped lint rows have NO control of any kind — no 'Fix', no 'Open'. If the 'Open' action has already been removed from 154:2 by that fix, the 48px inset is wrong and the text should simply run to the row's full width. READ THE ROW before insetting.

rows.what: a 'Draft preset' pill is drawn on top of an existing dark heading; only the ascenders of the word behind it show above the pill. The pill was added absolutely into a stack that already had a label at that y.

pill_node.selector: the INSTANCE or FRAME inside 306:2161 whose child TEXT reads 'Draft preset'

heading_node.selector: the TEXT inside 306:2161 that the pill's bounding box partially covers — VIS-2-13 reports it starts with 'D'

rows.fix: put the pill on the same baseline as the label with a horizontal gap (pill.x = label.right + 8). If that overflows the 280 panel, push the pill into its own row 24px down and shrink the list below by 24.
rows.do_not: if the parent is auto-layout, make the pill a sibling ROW rather than an absolute child — an absolute child in an auto-layout stack is how this happened.
rows.tooling_note: VIS-2-32 records that render-defects.mjs cannot see this class at all: its OVERPRINT check filters BOTH sides to TEXT (render-defects.mjs:118), so a pill-over-text pair is structurally invisible to it. Do not treat a clean render-defects sweep as proof this is fixed — read the two nodes' boxes.
